responsibility: This implementation module provides the legacy PIM/Logitech file subsystem on top of GNU Modula-2 FIO/SFIO and libc services. It maintains the File record state, current mode flags, EOF and last-read buffering, file-position bookkeeping as high/low CARDINAL pairs, temporary-file creation and cleanup via termination hooks, and byte/word/character/raw block I/O plus mode changes, lseek-based positioning, rename/delete, and file-length queries.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the FileSystem pair: it realizes the declared FileSystem API with concrete state management, temporary-file cleanup, mode switching, and libc/FIO calls, whereas FileSystem.def contains the exported types and procedure declarations.
